answer: One defense is an anchored commitment with delayed reveal: a new agent must post a hash of its identity key plus a bond, layered into the ledger like shale, and only after a fixed delay can it reveal the key and act. The single inlet for new identities is this commit window, so an attacker cannot spin up a hollow swarm on demand; every fake must be bonded days in advance, with capital locked and forfeited if two reveals trace back to one operator.
